source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor reading change when temperature increase or decrease.
2. Send command: ipmitool sensor list
Check sensor threshold(upper/lower warning/critical) match with the spec
3. Heat up the sensor until higher than the warning and critical threshold
Check SEL when sensor reach to threshold

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Temperature should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.(including sdr type)
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
5. All TEMP_CRPS1~TEMP_CRPS2 should get pass result.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED; identifies power-system hazards but treats supplyable CRPS mapping, load and protection data as permanent blockage.

original_test_intent: Independently exercise CRPS1 and CRPS2 through approved thermal warning and critical thresholds, verify per-module SDR/SEL plus load-share, derating and system protection behavior, then prove both power supplies and redundancy recover.
original_method: An engineer changes the thermal or electrical-load condition for the two CRPS modules while IPMI observes sensors. The source does not define CRPS, map the modules, or specify how each unit is heated without compromising power redundancy.
manual_activity: An engineer maps both CRPS modules and sensors, confirms AC feeds and redundancy, approves an electrical-load or environmental method that can demonstrate each unit without removing power, and remains present with load-shed and recovery authority.
required_inputs: CRPS definition plus PSU model/serial/firmware, physical bay, AC feed, sensor and SDR mapping for modules 1 and 2
rated input/output, actual voltage/current/power, load-share tolerance, redundancy policy and headroom
PMBus or vendor PSU telemetry/status and fan-speed visibility where supported
per-module temperature limits, hysteresis, SEL event data, derating/fault/shutdown expectations
system/electronic load or environmental stimulus with per-module coupling, ramp, dwell, maximum, abort and cooldown
calibrated probes, rail/host/BMC telemetry, evidence retention and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Do not disconnect AC, hot-remove a PSU, force load-share settings or alter sensor thresholds as a substitute for thermal stimulus; those are separate service-impacting tests.
Prove the remaining redundancy and power headroom before raising system load, and monitor actual input/output power of both modules so one unit's heat is not credited to the other.

Continuously monitor module temperatures/fans, PMBus or vendor faults, load share, output rails, redundancy, host and BMC; abort on derating, current/voltage fault, redundancy loss, overshoot or instability.
Preserve the first module-specific SEL, PMBus and rail fault evidence; do not clear logs or auto-retry.
Reduce load/ambient condition, restore nominal cooling and verify both modules, rail stability and redundancy recover before continuation.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, bind CRPS1/2 samples to exact serial/bay/AC-feed/SDR identities and baseline load share, fan, PMBus/status and rails.

Run only the approved load profile or monitor engineer-operated environmental equipment while collecting synchronized per-module temperature, input/output power, fan, SEL, rail, redundancy and host evidence.
Produce two independent threshold/assert/deassert and recovery rows plus shared load-share/redundancy behavior; one module cannot satisfy both.
Do not disconnect power, hot-swap modules, change load-share/thresholds, apply physical heat, clear evidence, auto-retry or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve CRPS/PSU identities, redundancy/headroom, load or environment plan, limits, event/derating/protection matrix and recovery.
Operate physical/environmental setup and retain emergency load-shed/shutdown authority.
Assess power-quality or redundancy anomalies and issue per-module plus overall DUT verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The SDR/sensor lists are baseline-only, expose credentials/disable host verification and do not create temperature transitions, inspect SEL or prove module-specific power behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved authenticated OOB IPMI/SEL plus per-module PMBus/vendor read-only telemetry, calibrated probes, input/output/load-share, rail and host monitoring during an engineer-approved load or environmental profile.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The CRPS1~2 target, high-level IPMI commands, heat-above-threshold intent, script and 5/10-minute values remain; Project defines actual load, dwell and safe access.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT DUAL-CRPS LOAD AND REDUNDANCY PLAN REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map both modules, baseline load share/redundancy, apply a bounded per-module-coupled load or ambient condition, correlate SEL/derating/protection, then unload/cool and prove redundant power recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact chassis, CRPS model/population, AC-feed architecture, load-share firmware and airflow design.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record PSU model/serial/firmware, BMC/SDR, PMBus/vendor tool, load equipment and probe versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor CRPS thermal/derating, load-share, PMBus/status, redundancy and recovery specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable module identity, measured load share, PMBus/rail faults and explicit redundancy recovery without introducing hot-swap or AC-loss actions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Static sensor visibility or one hotter PSU cannot prove both channels, their independent events or continued redundant power behavior.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Module/feed map, load-share baseline, qualified stimulus, limits/events and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A shared system load may distribute unevenly; a thermal fault can derate one module and remove redundancy before its BMC critical threshold is observed.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may use system load, electronic load or chamber/ducted air, but must document actual per-module power and thermal coupling, method equivalence and any protection path not exercised. AC removal or hot-swap requires a separate approved test and cannot be implied here.
expected_evidence: rated and measured input/output/load share, redundancy/headroom and PMBus/status baseline
approved load/environment profile, calibrated probes and abort record
timestamped per-module temperature/fan/power, SEL, PMBus faults, rails, redundancy and host/BMC state
decoded warning/critical assert/deassert and derating/failover/shutdown timing
reduced load, cooldown, cleared transient fault by approved recovery, restored load share/redundancy/rail/host/BMC health and engineer verdicts

Physical stimulus and emergency power response stay engineer-owned; telemetry correlation is automatable after setup.
